takeaways.text: Lines up **Slot** on **57%** of 292 plays (n=167); also Inline (tight) 32% (n=93).
Route on **96%** / blocks on **4%** of dropbacks (95% CI 93–98%, n=292) — 10 pts above the TE average of 86%.
From **SINGLEBACK** (formation), route rate is **79%** (CI 62–89%, n=33) — less likely to run a route than his overall 96%.

Because he releases into a route on ~96% of dropbacks and most often from Slot, a coach might account for him as a receiver there rather than expecting help in protection — to be validated against film and matchup.

farthest from his median depth — an outlier, NOT representative
